# System Validation Report

**Project:** Attendance Management System  
**Deliverable:** 3 (Testing) - Phase 3  
**Report date:** 2026-11-17 (automated runs 2026-11-17; manual validation run 2026-11-17)  
**Status of this report:** automated validation complete; the 19 manual validation cases were executed by Playwright automation (instructor-approved): 17 PASS, 1 BLOCKED, 1 NOT RUN (section 10).  
**Generated by:** `scripts/build_phase3_reports.py` from the Test Case Document catalogue and the saved evidence.

## 1. Purpose and approach

This report validates the system against the SRS (FR-01 to FR-15, NFR-01 to NFR-06) using the 197 cases of the Test Case Document v2.6. Each case's status is derived automatically from the JUnit evidence of the final run. The 19 manual validation cases were executed by Playwright automation following the checklist steps; the instructor approved this as manual validation evidence. No person performed those steps; the named team member is the responsible test owner.

| Validation layer | What it covers | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Automated integration (pytest + Flask test client) | 672 results in the regression run: every API workflow, role checks, validation, database behaviour, on a temporary SQLite database per test | docs/evidence/regression/junit.xml |
| Automated browser (Playwright) | End-to-end admin, teacher and student workflows in a real browser; NFR-02 page-load timing | docs/evidence/regression/junit.xml, docs/evidence/regression/browsers/ |
| Manual validation cases (Playwright automation, instructor-approved) | The 19 checklist scenarios executed in Google Chrome 157.0.8103.79 (Playwright channel 'chrome', headless) on an isolated validation_demo.db | docs/manual_validation/*.md, docs/evidence/regression/manual_validation_automation/, docs/Manual_Validation_Automation_Report.md |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| Final run (original) | 2026-11-11 | docs/evidence/final/ | 856 results: 836 passed, 1 failed, 12 errors, 7 skipped | 182 PASS, 6 FAIL, 4 BLOCKED, 4 NOT RUN, 1 NOT APPLICABLE (with the original manual validation run) |

## 5. Automated integration validation

Regression run: 672 integration-level results - 665 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 7 skipped (Sprint 1 placeholders). 51 of the 52 application view functions in the URL map (Flask's built-in static view excluded) executed during the measured coverage run; never executed: `app/api/attendance_management.py:get_attendance`. The tests cover authentication and role restrictions (FR-01, NFR-01), marking and editing (FR-02, FR-03), percentages and alerts (FR-04, FR-11), viewing, filtering, reporting and export (FR-05, FR-06, FR-10, FR-12), administration (FR-07 to FR-09), password change and logout (FR-13, FR-15).

The IT-level cases of the Test Case Document: PASS 75, NOT RUN 1.

NFR-02 page-load tests in Playwright Chromium (`test_nfr02_browser_performance.py`): 6 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (3.0-second limit and 1,500-record data set, as defined in that test file).

- **WebKit is not Safari.** The WebKit results are engine-level evidence only. The Safari application is untested: SYS_NFR-05_08 (Tharith) is BLOCKED because Playwright cannot drive it and enabling safaridriver was not approved.
- **D-01 (WebKit console errors) - closed.** In the original run (Playwright 1.64.1, WebKit build r2370) WebKit logged one false-positive `style-src-attr` violation per `<select>` element, also on a blank page with no inline styles: an upstream WebKit regression (Playwright issue #43617, fixed in WebKit 324283@main). With the approved upgrade to Playwright 1.65.2 (WebKit build r2388) the CSP probe records WebKit admin 0 violations / 19 selects, teacher 0 violations / 11 selects, student 0 violations / 2 selects; Chromium 0 violations (`docs/evidence/regression/browsers/webkit_csp_probe_output.txt`). The application's security policy was not changed.
- **Firefox** remains BLOCKED locally: Playwright Firefox build 1572 still fails to start on this Mac ("Could not find profile folder"); the team may run `NFR05_BROWSERS=firefox` on another machine.
- **Edge** is BLOCKED (not installed; installation not approved).

NFR-03 (reliability) cases: UT_NFR-03_01 PASS, IT_NFR-03_02 PASS, IT_NFR-03_03 NOT RUN, SYS_NFR-03_04 PASS, SYS_NFR-03_05 NOT RUN, IT_NFR-03_06 PASS.

- **Test isolation:** every test uses its own temporary database; the real `attendance.db` SHA-1 was identical before and after every Phase 2 and Phase 3 run, and the user's crontab was unchanged.
- **Restore (IT_NFR-03_03):** NOT RUN - there is no restore script (gap G-07); to be checked manually.
- **O-01 (data integrity, Low):** the enrollment API accepts a subject that is not linked to the chosen class. Verified on a temporary database (`docs/evidence/phase3/o01_enrollment_probe_output.txt`): the request returns 201 and the teacher roster for that class/subject then lists the student. The admin dashboard only offers the class's own subjects, so this cannot happen through normal UI use. SRS FR-09 ("assign students to their respective classes and subjects") implies the subject belongs to the class, so this is a genuine but minor API validation gap, not a missing feature. Not fixed.

FR-12 requires authorized users to export reports; without a control, users can only type an API URL. | Closed in the regression run: export controls added | SYS_FR-12_10 (PASS); UT/IT/SYS_FR-12_01..09 PASS via API |
| G-03 | FR-10 | Dashboard filters have no class filter and no date-range filter (the API supports both). | Class filter: yes (FR-10 names student, subject, class or date). Date range: not explicitly. | Closed in the regression run: class and date-range filters added | SYS_FR-10_10 (PASS) |
| G-04 | FR-11 | No screen to view or change the alert threshold; changed only through the admin API (default 75%). | No. FR-11 requires identifying students below a specified threshold, which works via configuration/API; alerts are shown on dashboards. | Optional UI convenience | SYS_FR-11_10 (PASS, dashboard display check) |
| G-05 | FR-05 | No pagination and no user-selectable sort. | No. FR-05 requires viewing by subject and date only. | Outside the SRS (original Test Plan expectation) | SYS_FR-05_09 (NOT APPLICABLE); SYS_FR-05_08 (PASS, fixed order) |

Other open gaps (not frontend): G-06 FR-04 - Design note; G-07 NFR-03 - Test Plan expectation without tooling; G-08 NFR-01 - Environmental limitation (deployment); G-09 NFR-05 - Environmental limitation; G-10 Several - Test gap - CLOSED in Phase 2.

Functions and appearance are unaffected; Chrome and Chromium log nothing. | SYS_NFR-05_04 FAIL (original run); PASS in the regression run | Fixed and verified in the regression run (2026-11-17): upstream WebKit regression (false-positive style-src-attr violation for <select>), fixed in WebKit 324283@main; re-run with Playwright 1.65.2 / WebKit r2388 shows 0 violations. After Deliverable 3 testing the six failed cases were fixed (approved production changes to the browser UI only: JavaScript, CSS and templates) and re-verified in the regression run: D-01, D-02, D-03 and MV-01 to MV-03 are closed. D-01 needed no application change: it was an upstream WebKit regression, resolved by the approved Playwright 1.65.2 / WebKit r2388 upgrade, and the security policy was not relaxed. D-04 and the O-xx observations remain open.

### 10.2 Other cases not yet executed

| Case | Scenario | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| SYS_FR-15_08 | Logout cannot be forged cross-site | Not verified: the linked CSRF test posts to /api/users, not /api/logout. The Origin check is global, but no test proves it for logout. |
| IT_NFR-03_03 | Restore backup | Partially verified by automated tests: the backup contains exactly the saved attendance rows and is unaffected by later changes. Not yet verified: restoring the backup into a database and using it through the application. |
| SYS_NFR-03_05 | Failure recovery | Partially verified by automated tests: a failed batch rolls back completely and a missing database fails safely. Not yet verified: retrying the same save after the failure. |

## 11. Conclusion

188 of 197 cases PASS. 0 FAIL (the six failures of the original runs were fixed and re-verified; defects D-01, MV-01, MV-02, MV-03, D-02, D-03 closed), 4 BLOCKED (SYS_NFR-01_04, SYS_NFR-05_02, SYS_NFR-05_03, SYS_NFR-05_08), 1 NOT APPLICABLE (SYS_FR-05_09), and 4 NOT RUN (SYS_FR-15_08, IT_NFR-03_03, SYS_NFR-03_05, SYS_NFR-04_06). The manual validation cases were executed by Playwright automation (17 PASS, 1 BLOCKED, 1 NOT RUN); SYS_NFR-04_06 (human usability walkthrough) is NOT RUN and SYS_NFR-05_08 (Safari application) is BLOCKED. The fixes changed only browser-side files; no backend endpoint, schema or security header changed.
